a: Binary floats cannot represent many decimals exactly — use integers/decimals for money.
Loop bounds and inclusive/exclusive ranges often cause off-by-one bugs.
Storing local time without zone causes DST and region errors — store UTC.
Assume values may be missing; validate before dereference.
Concurrent read-modify-write without synchronization loses updates.
Stale caches serve wrong data; define TTLs and explicit invalidation.
Mismatched encodings corrupt text — standardize on UTF-8.
Unvalidated paths allow ../ access to sensitive files.
Missing anti-CSRF tokens let other sites trigger authenticated actions.
Unclosed files/connections exhaust limits — use finally/context managers.
